notes.title: New Update 1.1.0
notes.notes: [p]We present to you the first full-fledged update, with the addition of a new game mode.[/p][h3]What's New:[/h3][list][*][p]Singleplayer mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Records are now separated by difficulty levels and game modes.[/p][/*][*][p]Added AZERTY support. On first launch, players with French localization will have the AZERTY layout selected by default. The current layout can be changed in the settings: Video/Screen/Layout.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Minor Fixes:[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where menu buttons would disappear if "Back" was pressed on the main button layer.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted collisions on a level.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the checkpoint sequence on "Hard" difficulty.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to use cooperative jump throughout the entire location.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.5 (Old Version)
notes.notes:
[p]Due to the recent major update, we received feedback from you that the Multiplayer mode is not working for some.
[/p][p align="start"]We are forced to temporarily roll back the new version of the game and are now urgently fixing these issues to eventually release a full update that won’t disrupt the gameplay.
[/p][h3]We appreciate your understanding, thank you![/h3]

notes.title: News & Future Updates
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone! We have some very exciting news for you! 🎉
[/p][p]We’d like to share a bit about our plans for the development of Try to Drive, so you know what to expect from the game in the near future.
[/p][p]Right now, we’re working on new connection modes and co-op features to give you a completely fresh gameplay experience.
[/p][h3]In the near future, you can expect:[/h3][list][*][p][b]Single Player —[/b] for those who enjoy challenges solo, without any “interference” from a friend.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Share Screen —[/b] a cozy co-op mode on one device. The main thing here is to finish the session on good terms, since in this mode you won’t be separated by miles of internet cables.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Additionally, in upcoming updates you’ll get:[/h3][list][*][p]Support for AZERTY keyboards;[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Individual bike customization;[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Individual character customization;[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Small thematic 🎃 maps to complete.[/p][/*][/list][p]And of course, we’re listening to each of you! Share your ideas and suggestions with us — we really want to see and implement them!
[/p][h3]Stay with us and enjoy the game 🎮[/h3]

[h2]Change List[/h2][list][*][p]Optimized netcode. Issues with bicycle "teleportation" have been eliminated. Also reduced input latency for the client.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the rotation force when tilting the bicycle. Performing tricks in the air is now much easier.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Fix List[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where the restart effect did not play for the Client if the bicycle entered a tunnel in the car location.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the Client did not hear the sound of cannon shots.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the Host saw a "Waiting for players" message over the loading interface.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Share your impressions!
notes.notes:
[p]We decided to run an unusual interactive session directly through Steam.
[/p][p]If you have any questions❓ during the game or while purchasing — this is a great opportunity to ask and get a quick answer.
[/p][h3]Leave your questions and suggestions in the comments below👇[/h3]

[h2]Change List[/h2][list][*][p]When loading a race, all players start simultaneously. You won't lose a single second waiting for your partner anymore![/p][/*][*][p]Added restart zones in the tunnels on the car location.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Fix List[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where both players would start the game as the rear rider if the Host chose to change position in the lobby before the Client connected.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where the client incorrectly displayed the notification about reaching a new checkpoint.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the settings might not match the displayed values in the menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the client's camera could tilt to the side.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed sounds during level loading.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the client saw tutorials when re-entering already completed areas.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Try To Drive launches today!
notes.notes:
[p]We have finished development and are excited to present you with the final product — a new co-op game for two players, where you both control a single bike.
[/p][p][b]The main goal?[/b] Reach the top, or (to be honest), keep your friendship intact along the way.
[/p][p]👉 [b]What awaits you in the game:[/b][/p][p]- A split-control system for the bike;[/p][p]- Themed locations and a variety of level challenges;[/p][p]- Physics is everything: tilts, jumps, and collisions — all follow the laws of reality.
[/p][p][b]This is a game about emotions:[/b] not just finishing it, but experiencing it together with your friend — through shouts, falls, and victories.
[/p][h3]Welcome![/h3]

notes.title: Tomorrow is release day!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Tomorrow, Try To Drive launches —[/b] a co-op game where you and your friend control one bike together.
[/p][p]What’s waiting for you❓ Lots of laughter, unexpected moments, and a real test of friendship. One player steers, the other hits the gas — and every turn becomes a little adventure.
[/p][p]🎉 [b]Release is tomorrow, September 11.[/b]
[/p][h3]Add the game to your wishlist so you don’t miss it![/h3]

notes.title: Try To Drive is coming this September
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hi, Friends![/b][/p][p]We need a little more time to bring the project to the level of quality it truly deserves.[/p][p][/p][h3]Here’s what you can expect in the final version:[/h3][p]🚴 [b]Co-op like you’ve never seen before —[/b] two players control one bike: one handles the gas and brake, the other steers. [/p][p]🎢 [b]Crazy themed locations —[/b] construction, office, highways, and even... candy❓ Every move counts. One wrong turn, and you’re falling.[/p][p]💥 [b]Physics that matter —[/b] realistic tilts, jumps, and crashes. Everything follows the laws of physics.[/p][p]🤝 [b]A game about emotions —[/b] we don’t want you to just beat the game, we want you to feel it. With a friend. Through shouting, falling, and winning together.[/p][p]💬 [b]Support us — hit Wishlist on Steam.[/b] It’s the best way to help us and make sure you don’t miss the launch.[/p][h3]
Thank you for your patience and support — we’re working hard to deliver a truly polished and memorable game.[/h3]
